justification: Both surfaces depict profile human figures in long garments, carved in low relief on a single upright panel with a band of small signs or symbols above the figural scene, and both include a subordinate smaller figure at a lower level. But A is dominated by one large striding figure towering over a crouching/kneeling figure at his feet, while B shows a row of four similarly sized standing figures facing one another in an interactive group, and the rendering differs (bold modelled relief with detailed costume versus thin schematic incised outlines).
